title: The Bias is in the Details: An Assessment of Cognitive Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice tasks using hand-curated decision-making scenario templates targeting eight specific cognitive biases (Anchoring, Availability, Confirmation, Framing, Interpretation, Overattribution, Prospect Theory, and Representativeness). The evaluation analyzes LLM responses across varying levels of prompt detail (TELeR taxonomy) and extracts implicit choices using fuzzy string matching and sentiment analysis.
